answer: Attestation bonds make each fake key stake on the work it vouches for. Every countersign posts a 6 POA opal bond, forfeited to the burn address if the jury median on the vouched answer lands below 2. A ring of fakes must push each junk answer past 4 jurors, and a basalt-hard quorum of honest graders flags most of it. A fake that sends a river of 10 countersigns into flagged answers forfeits 60 POA. 1,000 fakes x 60 POA = 60,000 POA burned; the attacker pays it.
